scope: Tinker post-trains Qwen3.5-4B LoRA walking/task/recovery selection on real branches. Full-route physics and qualification are unchanged. Branch eligibility uses local constraints; full-route native RMS limits apply to complete references and evaluations. Native gait and book-controller weights stay fixed. Prior zero-update usage, reference and parent measurements are explicitly carried.
display_note: Uninterrupted MuJoCo replay at actual recorded timestamps. Paper geometry and its forced crossing are absent. Every step attempt counts. Qualification requires all four tasks, balance, support and per-leg foot clearance. The native gait network and book controller remain fixed.

carried_baseline.scope: Unchanged physical simulator, action library, observations and full-route qualifier. Only branch eligibility changed. Existing parent evidence is reused with its original recording provenance.

scene.book_collision_scope: Fixed, nonsliding book terrain; visual meshes and collision envelopes share the same placements. No root motion is authored.
scene.revision_notes: Post-it stack removed from physics and rendering. Drawer-to-laptop transit is ordinary flat walking.

steps.definition: Measured unload, at least 30 ms and 2 mm sole motion or 8 degree rotation, followed by loaded touchdown with 40 ms dwell. Unfinished attempts retained.

direction_metrics.scope: Travel velocity averaged over one miniature gait cycle; turning and low-speed balance excluded. Raw rendered motion is unfiltered.

native_smoothness.scope: Only adjacent samples inside native walking and turning, excluding holds and book-controller phases.

flat_foot_clearance.definition: Lowest physical collision-pad point above the local surface, with the other foot loaded. Same sensor and detector for every policy.
